item.description:
SHIELDPRO — Magnetic Ring Phone Case

Upgrade your daily mobile protection with the SHIELDPRO Magnetic Ring Phone Case, engineered specifically for iPhone 17 and iPhone 18 series devices. Featuring an innovative dual-purpose magnetic ring kickstand and full-coverage camera lens defense, this case delivers exceptional daily impact shielding while keeping your phone sleek and modern.

✅ FEATURES / KEY BENEFITS
• Strong Magnetic Connection: Built-in high-grade magnetic array aligns seamlessly with magnetic wireless chargers and car mounts, ensuring a stable, wobble-free hold during bumpy commutes without signal interference.
• Built-in Foldable Ring Stand: The flush magnetic ring flips out smoothly into a multi-angle kickstand, letting you enjoy hands-free landscape video viewing or portrait video calls anywhere on flat tables and desks.
• Integrated Full-Coverage Lens Protection: Custom raised camera bezel features built-in individual lens protectors that shield your delicate camera glass against scratches and dust without buying separate protector films.
• Shock-Resistant Drop Defense: Engineered with flexible impact-absorbing TPU bumper edges and reinforced corners that disperse sudden shock from everyday accidental drops, table bumps, and unexpected slips.
• Matte Frosted Anti-Fingerprint Finish: Translucent backplate delivers a sophisticated frosted texture that actively repels oily fingerprints, smudges, and sweaty palm marks while preserving a clean, premium hand feel.

📋 PRODUCT DETAILS
Brand: SHIELDPRO
Material: Translucent PC Backplate, Flexible TPU Bumper, Magnetic Array, Glass Lens Protectors
Color: Wine Red, Black, Titanium Grey, White, Deep Blue, Light Blue, Vibrant Orange
Compatibility: iPhone 17 & iPhone 18 Series
